title: Astrid and the Drop
author: A. M. Okafor
blurb: Tamsin Thackeray, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
